Anna (CS): quick heads up — Juniper asked for a short "micro-clinic" next Wed focused on onboarding + a hands-on model push. They prefer APAC-friendly times. Can we coordinate hosts and a backup?
Diego (CS): I can take the overlap block (13:00-15:00 UTC). @Sam (AE) any chance you can do the APAC block?
Sam (AE): I can do 04:00-05:00 UTC only (early morning for me). Not comfortable covering the full 04:00-06:00. Could pair with Lisa for the second hour.
Lisa (CE): I can cover 05:00-06:00 UTC, happy to walk the troubleshooting portion. Agenda bullets from my side: runbook review + demo of rolling back model pins.
Anna (CS): thanks — proposed blocks: 04:00-06:00 UTC (APAC-friendly) and 13:00-15:00 UTC (EMEA/NA overlap). Agenda draft: 1) infra quick tour (15m) 2) model pin/rollout demo (20m) 3) KV cache troubleshooting + logs (15m) 4) hands-on lab (25m) 5) Q&A (15m). Keep to 1.5h.
Sam (AE): Juniper wants to push a tiny model update during the lab. We'll need a sandbox GPU. @Operations can we request 1x small GPU for Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC?
Operations (ops): confirmed we can allocate 1x T4 for sandbox Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC. Need the account id and SSH user.
Anna (CS): account id juniper-123, I'll DM SSH user. Also can we add a backup host in case someone cancels? Diego can you be backup for either block?
Diego (CS): yep I can be backup for either block, just ping me 24h before to confirm.
Lisa (CE): runbook draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/juniper-microclinic-runbook — includes check commands and sample requests. I'll add a TL;DR checklist at top. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Poll created — https://cal.redwood/s/juniper-microclinic (vote for preferred block).
Anna (CS): perfect. I'll consolidate responses and post the final invite + Zoom link by EOD Monday. Will include the runbook link and prep checklist. Thanks everyone :party:
